title: Release asset set: model lifecycle + pricing overview screenshots
creator: Maya Patel
description: Produce a comprehensive set of UX assets and screenshots for the upcoming catalog release notes and quickstart docs. Scope covers: 1) new model launch hero and detail screenshots, 2) deprecation banners and migration callouts, 3) pricing tier overlays and per-unit cost callouts, 4) compact screenshots for release notes digest and email templates, and 5) quickstart visual flows for onboarding (pinning model versions, selecting billing tier). Assets must be export-ready for engineering docs (PNG 2x / WebP), marketing release notes, and lightweight variants for the Console quickstart modal. Design must include light/dark variants and mobile responsive crops. Accessibility checks required for contrast and alt-textables. Coordinate with PM for messaging and ENG for exact model-slug and price strings.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Deliver a Figma file with named frames for every asset type (hero, detail, deprecation ribbon, pricing overlay, email digest), 2) Provide PNG (2x) and WebP exports in designated folder, 3) Include copy variants approved by PM, 4) All images pass WCAG AA contrast for text overlays, 5) Finalized assets uploaded to release notes Confluence page and a GitHub PR referencing assets
deliverables: Console quickstart modal crops (desktop, tablet, mobile)
design_notes: Avoid reusing earlier catalog tile layouts; introduce a compact card that emphasizes model variant, tokens-per-second benchmark, and price-per-1k tokens badge. Deprecation ribbon should be prominent but non-alarmist (muted amber with clear migration CTA). Pricing overlay uses the new rounded badge style from style-guide v3. Include a micro-illustration to indicate 'new model' that follows the brand expression (single-color stroke + subtle gradient).
specs: Hero: 1440x540 px, Detail: 1200x800 px, Email digest: 600x200 px, Quickstart modal: 960x420 px with 3 responsive crops. Text overlays must be selectable where possible in Console exports. Exports named: DES-15023-hero.png, DES-15023-detail-<variant>.webp, DES-15023-deprecation-ribbon.png
